notes.title: Season 1 Patch Notes Released
notes.notes: [p]On 24 September 2025 at 06:00 (UTC), we applied balance adjustments and bug fixes.[/p][p]　[/p][hr][/hr][p]　[/p][h1]Buffs[/h1][p]　[/p][p]　[/p][h2]・Frieza (First Form)[/h2][p]　　[/p][h3][u]Skills1 Show Them, Zarbon![/u][/h3][p]・Cooldown time reduced: 30→20 seconds[/p][p]・Cooldown reduction based on Zarbon's remaining HP upon retreat increased: 60–40→80–40%[/p][p]・Time to reach maximum range reduced: 5→3 seconds[/p][p]・Effect of “Strike Defense Down” applied to enemies reduced: 100→50[/p][p]　[/p][h3][u]Skills 3: Imperial Decree[/u][/h3][p]・Increased boost speed when Dodoria is enhanced: 200% → 250%[/p][p]・Increased attack interval reduction when Zarbon is enhanced: 40% → 60%[/p][p]　　[/p][p]　[/p][h2]・Piccolo[/h2][p]　[/p][h3][u]Skills 1: Light Grenade[/u][/h3][p]・Cooldown time reduced: 20→15 seconds[/p][p]・Damage dealt increased: 2520/2800/3360→3000/3280/3560[/p][p]　　[/p][h3][u]Super Attack:Special Beam Cannon[/u][/h3][p]・Maximum Charge Time Reduction: 4→3 seconds[/p][p]　　[/p][p]　[/p][h2]・Son Goku (Mini)[/h2][p]　　[/p][h3][u]Rush Attack[/u][/h3][p]・Damage Increase: 33→41[/p][p]　　　　[/p][hr][/hr][p]　　　[/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]　　[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where the effect of “Frieza (First Form)”‘s Passive 'Fearsome Emperor’ could be interrupted by ally healing or contact with areas generated by himself or allies.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where skills targeting enemies or allies would activate without a valid target right before switching to GEKISHIN Burst.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where Zen-Oh would disappear if a triple KO occurred right before he returned to his starting point.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where Dragon Ball didn't display correctly when obtained.[/p][p]　　　[/p][hr][/hr][p]　　[/p][p]We appreciate your continued support of “DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA”.[/p]

notes.title: DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA works great on Linux PCs and Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Bandai Namco Entertainment released DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA, a free to play MOBA set in the Dragon Ball universe and it works well on Linux / Steam Deck.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/09/dragon-ball-gekishin-squadra-works-great-on-linux-pcs-and-steam-deck/

notes.title: The Official Launch of DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA Is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]SQUAD UP, BEAT DOWN![/b][/h1][h1][b]Dragon Ball's First 4vs4 Team Battle is Here![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/4f7f633bfc250114f2e9b9859f5f43a1e652d6df.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc. has launched the 4vs4 real-time strategy game [b]DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA[/b]. [b]DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA[/b] is Dragon Ball's first team-oriented free-to-play game, where players can fight as the series’ iconic characters in an all-out tactical battle.[/p][p][/p][h2]◆[b]5 new characters join the fight![/b][/h2][p]In addition to the 17 heroes that have appeared so far, 5 new heroes will join the fight![/p][p]Cell (Perfect Form)／Android 17／Hit／Super Saiyan Kale (Berserk)／Gamma 1 & Gamma 2[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/b13b3cf559cba792c4855ea03811d71936fa5cf1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/7ad07466a2a17ac352350713a22709eb696cdd71.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/9a5b8b691bd94f5dc01ba7f4b146e9c9caa02322.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/c8d2cf8fb27849d1ac1c135a660a49a21de1d8cc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/3e7f786b87df2f4b95ca69ecbc855ee379bf6218.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2]◆What is DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="ojhY1xAAQyc;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]◆ Intense 4 VS 4 Team Battle[/h3][p]Enter the world of Dragon Ball by bringing your favorite characters' earth-shaking strength to the battlefield, and join up with your friends and allies to defeat your opponents and dominate the objectives.[/p][p]Grow your strength throughout the battle, unlock game-changing skills, and obliterate enemy players and bosses alike.
[/p][h3]◆ Heroes With Roles[/h3][p]Pick heroes with unique abilities and skills to fulfill strategic roles for your team:[/p][p]- DAMAGE: Simple but effective, super aggressive play style with a focus to take down the enemy[/p][p]- TANK: Persistent and hard to K.O., help your team hold the field and soak up the enemy's attacks[/p][p]- TECHNICAL: Versatile support, maximize your team's chances by boosting your allies and disrupting the enemy
[/p][h3]◆ Customization[/h3][p]Personalize your favorite heroes in your own style with character skins, entrance animations, and special finisher animations.[/p][p]Find an aesthetic combination that shows off your love for the characters in your own way.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Squad Up with your friends and PLAY NOW![/b][/h2][h2][url="https://dbg-squadra.bn-ent.net/" style="button"]Official Website[/url][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072560/DRAGON_BALL_GEKISHIN_SQUADRA/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
